subject: Portal inventory change-control: snapshot & ownership
messages:
From: Tara Nguyen <tara@orbiton.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Harris <sam.harris@orbiton.com>
Date: 2027-09-29T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: New vendor portal onboarding & evidence snapshot request

Hi Marissa,

We met briefly during the procurement kickoff last week — Orbiton Systems is ready to move forward with sandbox access for your vendor portal so we can complete the SIG/CAIQ and SOC2 evidence collection. Procurement asked me to get the portal handoff going and verify the owner contact.

Can you please:
- Confirm whether we should use Vendr or Whistic for your profile (we prefer Vendr if it's available).
- Provide a short inventory snapshot (fields you expect us to fill) and a contact who will own evidence ingestion.
- Share any presign or S3 instructions for evidence uploads if you require us to push artifacts.

Attaching a filled SIG template that Orbiton typically sends to partners (column headers noted). I can also join a short 20–30 minute handoff this week if that helps.

Attachments: orbiton_SIG_request_20270929.xlsx

Thanks —
Tara Nguyen
Security Operations | Orbiton Systems
tara@orbiton.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

On Wed, Sep 29, 2027 at 08:15 AM Tara Nguyen <tara@orbiton.com> wrote:
> Hi Marissa — looping Sam (procurement) for scheduling.
>
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Nguyen <tara@orbiton.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-29T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor portal onboarding & evidence snapshot request

Hi Tara — great to hear from you and thanks for the SIG template.

Short answers up front:
- We prefer onboarding partners into Vendr for evidence ingestion (presign flow + manifest ingestion). If your procurement team insists on Whistic we can accept that too, but Vendr gives faster automation for presigned uploads.
- I'll own the onboarding cadence from the security side and will hand off platform upload/manifest details to Ben. Rishi will own SOC2 artifact mapping and Irene will validate any KMS/HSM proofs.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
1) This week: 20–30 min handoff — Tara/Procurement + Marissa + Ben (portal preflight) + Rishi (evidence mapping). Can you do Thu 9/30 10:00–10:30 PT?
2) Orbiton exports a small sample of 10 artifacts (SIG + a few SOC2 doc refs) and uploads to the presign bucket we provide.
3) Ben will run a manifest QC and return a delta checklist.
4) Rishi/Rachel (cc'd internally on follow-up) will map the sample to Redwood CAIQ/SOC2 fields and flag gaps.

I attached a quick checklist and a Vendr onboarding URL below. For uploads we prefer presigned S3 (temporary tokens) — Ben, please include the presign TTL and ACL constraints in the follow-up email.

Attachments: vendr_onboarding_screenshot_20270929.png
Links: https://vendr.example.com/onboard/Orbiton-12345

If that plan works, confirm Thu 10am PT and we'll send calendar invites.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Security Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

On Wed, Sep 29, 2027 at 08:15 AM Tara Nguyen <tara@orbiton.com> wrote:
> Attaching the SIG file now. Happy to take the handoff on Thu if that still works.
>
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-29T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Orbiton portal onboarding — quick assignment

Team — copying the original request below from Tara (Orbiton). Need quick ownership so procurement can hit their milestone. High level asks: presign uploads, sample manifest QC, SOC2/CAIQ mapping, and a verification call Thu 9/30 10am PT.

Please confirm ownership and next steps:
- Ben: OWN portal presign setup, provide TTL/ACL, and create a temporary presign bucket for the Orbiton sample upload. Deliverable: presign instructions + test URL by Thu 9/30 09:00 PT.
- Rishi: OWN mapping of the sample artifacts to our CAIQ/SOC2 canonical fields and list missing artifacts. Deliverable: mapping doc (spreadsheet) within 48 hours of upload.
- Irene: OWN cryptography and KMS proof verification (if Orbiton claims encryption keys or signed hashes). Deliverable: checklist for KMS/HSM proof requirements.

Notes:
- Orbiton included an initial SIG template (attached). We should ask them for a short manifest CSV that lists filenames, SHA256, doc type, and control mapping.
- If Orbiton insists on Whistic instead of Vendr, confirm whether we can still accept presign uploads through that flow.

Ben/Rishi/Irene, please reply-all with confirmations and any blockers. I'll schedule the Thu 10am invite once we have confirmations.

Thanks —
Marissa

On Wed, Sep 29, 2027 at 10:04 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-09-30T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Orbiton portal onboarding — quick assignment

Ack — I can take the presign flow. Quick notes / ask:
- I'll provision a 7-day presign bucket with object ACL set to private and put a manifest template in the root (presign manifest: presign_manifest_stub.csv).
- Orbiton should include SHA256 for each file; we'll validate checksums during ingestion.
- If Orbiton wants Whistic, we can accept a CSV export from their Whistic profile and then run a one-off presign ingest; Vendr remains preferred for automation.

I attached the presign manifest stub. Ben will post the presign URL and upload instructions in a separate email to Tara and procurement.

Attachments: presign_manifest_stub.csv

—Ben
Ben Carter
Vendor Integrations | Redwood Inference
